topic: News, rumors & quantifiers all / most / few / a few（新聞與謠言＋數量詞 all / most / few 陷阱）

shadow.speaker: Puma Shen 沈伯洋（立法委員；SCSP podcast《Straightforward》訪談〈Puma Shen on Cognitive Warfare & Civilian Defense〉）

chunks.text: So it doesn't needs to be… it doesn't need to be fake news.
I mean, we usually think about cognitive warfare, we're thinking about, hey, tons of fake news, I mean, uh, distributed by fake accounts, but that's not the case.
Sometime, I mean, I won't say sometimes, but 80% of the cognitive warfare is
about, I mean, real news, but they try to exaggerate or try to amplify it on the internet.

phrases.en: exaggerate or amplify it on the internet
phrases.zh: 在網路上誇大或放大它

respond.prompt_en: Most of the news we see online is not checked by anyone. How do you check whether a news story is true? Answer in one sentence.
respond.prompt_zh: 網路上大部分的新聞都沒人查證過。你會怎麼確認一則新聞是不是真的？用一句英文回答。（可以用 Most of the time, I… 或 I check whether it comes from a reliable source.）

vocab.example: Tom said he waited "forever" for the bus, but he was exaggerating. It was only five minutes.
vocab.note: 拼字陷阱：雙 g（exa-gg-erate）。名詞 exaggeration。沈伯洋原句：they try to exaggerate…

vocab.example: Social media can amplify a small mistake until everyone is talking about it.
vocab.note: 本義是把聲音放大：amplifier＝擴音器。B2 寫作常用：amplify a message / a problem。

vocab.example: There is a rumor that our school trip will be cancelled, but nobody knows if it's true.
vocab.note: 常見句型：There is a rumor that + 子句；spread a rumor（散播謠言）。英式拼法 rumour。

vocab.example: Before you share a story, check whether it comes from a reliable source.
vocab.note: rely on（依賴）→ reliable（可靠的）；反義 unreliable。a reliable source＝可靠的消息來源。

vocab.example: The teacher distributed the test papers to the whole class.
vocab.note: distribute A to B（把 A 分給 B）；名詞 distribution。沈伯洋原句：fake news distributed by fake accounts（被假帳號散佈的假新聞）。

grammar.title: 數量詞 all / most / some / few / a few（＋ other）
grammar.explain:
會考低答對率的數量詞陷阱：先看「後面的句子」在說多還是少！
① all＝全部；most＝大部分；some＝一些（肯定）。
② few＋可數複數＝「很少、幾乎沒有」→ 帶否定意味；a few＝「有一些」→ 肯定。little / a little 同樣邏輯，但接不可數名詞。
③ both 只能用在「兩個」；三個以上用 all。
④ 要接特定的一群（the / my / these）時要加 of：most of the students、all of my friends；但 most students（泛指）不加 the。
🔑 判斷法：找線索字！only、except、but 常常告訴你答案。「只有兩個人比他資深」→ 其他人「很少」→ Few other waiters。「除了廚房那一扇，窗戶都關了」→ All of the windows。
⚠️ 103 會考 all（答對率 33%）、108 會考 Few（30%）都是全國最低答對率的題目之一。
⭐ B2 加分：quite a few＝相當多（不是很少！）。
examples: 80% of the cognitive warfare is about real news. —— 沈伯洋原句：百分比＋of the＋名詞，就像 most of the news
Jogging is the only exercise I enjoy. I find all other kinds of exercise boring. —— 103 會考：只喜歡慢跑 → 其他「全部」都無聊 → all
Few people believed the rumor, so it didn't spread. —— few＝幾乎沒人（否定）
A few people believed the rumor, so it spread quickly. —— a few＝有一些人（肯定）

practice.question: There are many good restaurants on this street, but ___ of them are open after 10 p.m., so it's hard to get a late dinner.
practice.explanation: 後面說「很難吃到宵夜」→ 晚上十點後開的店「很少」→ few（否定意味）。a few 是「有一些」，跟「很難」不搭；all / most 意思相反。

uoe.passage: Last week a ___1___ spread around our school: summer vacation would be two weeks shorter! ___2___ of my classmates believed it at first, and some even shared it online. But only a ___3___ students checked the school website, and it said nothing like that. Our teacher reminded us that social media is not always a ___4___ source of news.

gaps.explanation: 在學校「傳開來」、後來證明不是真的 → rumor（謠言）。spread a rumor 是固定搭配。
後面說 some even shared it，還有 But only a few checked → 一開始「大部分人」都信了 → Most。Each / Every 不能接 of my classmates；Few 跟後文的「謠言傳開」矛盾。
only a few students＝只有少數幾個學生（a few＋可數複數）。a little 接不可數名詞；a lot 後面要加 of；沒有 a many。
a reliable source of news＝可靠的新聞來源。其他三個都是 r 開頭的形容詞，別被長相騙了！

quiz.question: ___ other waiters in the restaurant have worked here longer than Clark; only Lois and Lana started working here before him.
quiz.explanation: 線索是 only Lois and Lana → 比 Clark 資深的服務生「很少」→ Few（否定意味）。這題全國答對率只有約 30%！

quiz.question: I guess the rainwater has come in from the kitchen. See? ___ of the windows are closed except the one in the kitchen.
quiz.explanation: except the one in the kitchen＝「除了廚房那一扇」→ 其他窗戶「全部」關著 → All。Both 只能用在兩個；Most / Some 不會搭配 except 這種「只有一個例外」的說法。

quiz.question: Don't worry. I still have ___ minutes before the bus comes, so I can buy a drink.
quiz.explanation: 後面說「還來得及買飲料」→ 還有「一些」時間（肯定）→ a few；minutes 是可數複數，所以不用 a little。few 是「幾乎沒有」，意思相反。

quiz.question: Mia said the line was "a kilometer long," but it was really only about twenty people. She likes to ___.
quiz.explanation: 把二十個人說成一公里長 → 誇大 → exaggerate。

quiz.question: Before you share a news story, check whether it comes from a ___ source.
In the clip, what does Puma Shen say about 80% of cognitive warfare?
options: It uses real news but exaggerates or amplifies it online.
It is all fake news written by fake accounts.
It only happens on TV, not on the internet.
It is about cute animal videos.
quiz.explanation: 他說大家以為都是假帳號散佈假新聞，but that's not the case → 80% 其實是「真的新聞」，只是被誇大、放大。

dialog.greet: Hi Roby! 我是蔡老師 😊 今天聊「新聞與謠言」，順便破解會考超低答對率的 all / most / few 陷阱。Ready?
dialog.present: 先跟著沈伯洋的原聲唸一遍，再學 5 個單字。記住今天的口訣：先看後面在說「多」還是「少」！Let's go!
correct: Nice job, Roby! 你有抓到線索字 😎
Spot on! 全國只有三成的人答對這種題，你做到了！
wrong: Not quite. 沒關係，再看一次句子後半段在說多還是少 💪
Almost! 找找看有沒有 only、except、but 這種線索字？
Oops! 錯了也是在學習，再試一次～
dialog.hint: 小提示：few＝幾乎沒有（否定）、a few＝有一些（肯定）；兩個用 both，三個以上用 all。
dialog.submit: Ready to check? 送出前再檢查一次喔！
dialog.done: Well done, Roby! 今天的數量詞陷阱你都搞定了 🎉 Don't believe every rumor online. See you tomorrow!
